title: Selection menu actions

sections.heading: EDGE LOOP
sections.content:
An Edge Loop in ProBuilder topology is defined as a continuous chain of connected edges where, at each intermediate vertex, exactly 4 edges (spokes) meet (valence 4). When advancing through a valence-4 vertex, the loop steps through the 'opposite' edge—the spoke edge that shares neither of the two faces adjacent to the incoming edge.

The algorithm is implemented in `ElementSelection.GetEdgeLoop` and `ElementSelection.GetEdgeLoopIterative`:
1. Topological Conversion: `WingedEdge.GetWingedEdges(mesh)` builds a list of `WingedEdge` structures representing the mesh half-edge topology. The input `IEnumerable<Edge> edges` is converted to `EdgeLookup` items via `EdgeLookup.GetEdgeLookup(edges, mesh.sharedVertexLookup)`.
2. Tracking State: A `HashSet<EdgeLookup> sources` contains the starting edges, and `HashSet<EdgeLookup> used` accumulates all discovered loop edges.
3. Bidirectional Traversal (`GetEdgeLoop`):
   - For each `WingedEdge` in `wings` matching `sources`:
     - Traversal starts along endpoint vertex `wings[i].edge.common.b` via `GetEdgeLoopInternal(wings[i], wings[i].edge.common.b, used)`.
     - If `completeLoop` is false (meaning the loop did not close back on itself), traversal executes in the opposite direction along endpoint `wings[i].edge.common.a` via `GetEdgeLoopInternal(wings[i], wings[i].edge.common.a, used)`.
4. Spoke Evaluation in `GetEdgeLoopInternal(WingedEdge start, int startIndex, HashSet<EdgeLookup> used)`:
   - Initializes `int ind = startIndex` and `WingedEdge cur = start`.
   - Marks `used.Add(cur.edge)`.
   - Calls `GetSpokes(cur, ind, true).DistinctBy(x => x.edge.common).ToList()` to collect unique common edges meeting at pivot vertex `ind`.
   - Checks `spokes.Count == 4`: If exactly 4 spokes meet, the opposite edge is `spokes[2]`. Sets `cur = spokes[2]` and advances pivot index `ind = cur.edge.common.a == ind ? cur.edge.common.b : cur.edge.common.a`.
   - If `spokes.Count != 4` (such as at T-junctions, boundaries, valence-3 poles, or valence-5+ vertices), `cur` is set to null, terminating the walk in that direction.
5. Handling T-Junctions and Boundaries:
   - In `GetSpokes(WingedEdge wing, int sharedIndex, bool allowHoles = false)`, adjacent winged edges around pivot `sharedIndex` are gathered by calling `NextSpoke(cur, sharedIndex, opp)` and toggling `opp = !opp`.
   - If a boundary edge (a hole in geometry where `wing.opposite == null`) is encountered and `allowHoles == true`, it restarts traversal from `wing.opposite` in reverse to collect all spokes around the boundary fan.
   - At a T-junction or non-manifold seam, vertex valence is 3 or >= 5. Because `spokes.Count != 4`, `GetEdgeLoopInternal` stops traversal immediately, preventing ambiguous branching.
   - On a boundary vertex with valence < 4, `spokes.Count != 4`, which cleanly halts the loop at the mesh boundary.
6. Iterative Loop Expansion (`GetEdgeLoopIterative` / `GetEdgeLoopInternalIterative`):
   - When `m_SelectIterative` (`Pref<bool>("SelectEdgeLoop.selectIterative", false)`) is enabled, `SelectEdgeLoop` invokes `ElementSelection.GetEdgeLoopIterative`.
   - Instead of walking to completion, `GetEdgeLoopInternalIterative` computes spokes at `edge.a` (`spokesA`) and `edge.b` (`spokesB`). If `spokesA.Count == 4`, it adds `spokesA[2].edge` to `used`. If `spokesB.Count == 4`, it adds `spokesB[2].edge` to `used`. This expands the selection by at most 1 edge in each direction.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, HalfEdgeMesh or SurfaceTool mesh representations can replicate this by walking vertex valence. Quad valence-4 traversal stops when vertex edge count != 4.

sections.heading: EDGE RING
sections.content:
An Edge Ring in ProBuilder topology is defined as a series of edges that run parallel to each other across opposite sides of adjacent quad faces (oriented perpendicular to edge loops). Ring edges share quad faces with one another but do not share vertices.

The algorithm is implemented in `ElementSelection.GetEdgeRing` and `ElementSelection.GetEdgeRingIterative`:
1. Topological Setup: `WingedEdge.GetWingedEdges(pb)` builds winged edge structures. A dictionary `wings_dic` maps each `wings[i].edge.common` edge to its `WingedEdge`. `EdgeLookup.GetEdgeLookup(edges, pb.sharedVertexLookup).Distinct()` generates the lookup set.
2. Opposite Edge Computation via `EdgeRingNext(WingedEdge edge)`:
   - Sets `WingedEdge next = edge.next, prev = edge.previous; int i = 0;`.
   - Traverses around the face: `while (next != prev && next != edge)` -> `next = next.next; if (next == prev) return null; prev = prev.previous; i++;`.
   - Checks `if (i % 2 == 0 || next == edge) next = null; return next;`.
   - On a quad face (4 edges): `next` and `prev` meet at edge index 2 with `i = 1` (odd), returning the exact opposite `WingedEdge`. On a triangle (3 edges), `i = 0` (even), returning null. On polygons with != 4 sides, `EdgeRingNext` returns null, ensuring edge rings only traverse 4-sided faces.
3. Bidirectional Ring Traversal (`GetEdgeRing`):
   - For each input edge `we`:
     - Forward direction: sets `WingedEdge cur = we;`. While `cur != null`: `if (!used.Add(cur.edge)) break; cur = EdgeRingNext(cur); if (cur != null && cur.opposite != null) cur = cur.opposite;`.
     - Reverse direction: sets `cur = EdgeRingNext(we.opposite); if (cur != null && cur.opposite != null) cur = cur.opposite;`. While `cur != null`: `if (!used.Add(cur.edge)) break; cur = EdgeRingNext(cur); if (cur != null && cur.opposite != null) cur = cur.opposite;`.
4. Iterative Ring Expansion (`GetEdgeRingIterative`):
   - When `m_SelectIterative` (`Pref<bool>("SelectEdgeRing.selectIterative", false)`) is enabled in `SelectEdgeRing`:
   - From `cur = we`, gets `next = EdgeRingNext(cur)`. If `next != null && next.opposite != null && !used.Contains(next.edge)`, adds `next.edge`.
   - Gets `prev = EdgeRingNext(cur.opposite)`. If `prev != null && prev.opposite != null && !used.Contains(prev.edge)`, adds `prev.edge`.
   - Expands the ring selection by at most 1 edge step in each direction.
5. Termination Conditions:
   - Traversal terminates when `EdgeRingNext` returns null (hitting a triangle or n-gon), when `cur.opposite == null` (reaching a boundary hole or perimeter edge), or when `used.Add(cur.edge)` returns false (encountering an already visited edge in a closed periodic ring).
sections.godot_notes: Godot half-edge implementations can implement `EdgeRingNext` by advancing `half_edge.next.next` on quad faces, stepping across `half_edge.opposite` to cross face boundaries.

sections.heading: FACE LOOP/RING
sections.content:
Face Loops and Face Rings represent contiguous sequences of connected quad faces across opposite edges:
- A Face Loop is a contiguous strip of quad faces progressing along the initial edge orientation of the face (nominally aligning with the local Z/V coordinate direction).
- A Face Ring is a contiguous strip of quad faces running perpendicular to the face loop (shifted 90 degrees around the quad, nominally aligning with the local X/U coordinate direction).
- Relationship to Edge Loops: A face loop is bounded on its left and right sides by two parallel edge loops, and traverses across a sequence of edge ring segments.

The algorithm is implemented in `ElementSelection.GetFaceLoop` and `ElementSelection.GetFaceRingAndLoop`:
1. Topological Conversion: `List<WingedEdge> wings = WingedEdge.GetWingedEdges(mesh)`.
2. `GetFaceLoop(List<WingedEdge> wings, Face face, bool ring)` Traversal:
   - Finds the starting wing for the face: `WingedEdge start = wings.FirstOrDefault(x => x.face == face)`.
   - If `ring == true`, shifts the starting wing to an adjacent edge on the face: `start = start.next ?? start.previous;`.
   - Iterates in two directions (`for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)`):
     - Pass `i = 0`: begins at `cur = start`.
     - Pass `i = 1`: begins at `cur = start.opposite` (if `start.opposite != null && start.opposite.face != null`).
     - Inner stepping loop:
       - `if (!loop.Add(cur.face)) break;` (terminates on closed loop cycle).
       - `if (cur.Count() != 4) break;` (validates that the face is a quad with exactly 4 edges; non-quad faces terminate the loop).
       - Advances across the quad: `cur = cur.next.next.opposite;` (moves 2 edges forward around the quad to the opposite edge, then crosses through `opposite` into the neighboring face).
       - Continues while `cur != null && cur.face != null`.
3. Combined Face Loop and Ring (`GetFaceRingAndLoop`):
   - `ElementSelection.GetFaceRingAndLoop(ProBuilderMesh mesh, Face[] faces)` evaluates both `GetFaceLoop(wings, face, true)` and `GetFaceLoop(wings, face, false)` and merges them via `loops.UnionWith(...)`.
4. Action Handlers and Routing:
   - `SelectFaceLoop.PerformActionImplementation`: calls `ElementSelection.GetFaceLoop(pb, pb.selectedFacesInternal)` (`ring = false`). Shortcut: `Shift + Double-Click` on a face.
   - `SelectFaceRing.PerformActionImplementation`: calls `ElementSelection.GetFaceLoop(pb, pb.selectedFacesInternal, true)` (`ring = true`). Shortcut: `Control + Double-Click` on a face.
   - `SelectFaceRing.MenuRingAndLoopFaces`: calls `ElementSelection.GetFaceRingAndLoop(pb, pb.selectedFacesInternal)`. Shortcut: `Shift + Control + Double-Click` on a face.
   - Menu Proxies `SelectLoop` and `SelectRing`: check `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode`. When in `SelectMode.Edge`, they execute `SelectEdgeLoop` / `SelectEdgeRing`; when in `SelectMode.Face`, they execute `SelectFaceLoop` / `SelectFaceRing`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot plugin implementation can traverse `half_edge.next.next.opposite` on 4-sided faces, toggling the starting half-edge offset to switch between loop and ring traversal.

sections.heading: SELECT HOLE
sections.content:
A hole in ProBuilder mesh topology is a closed perimeter loop of boundary edges (open edges where `opposite == null`) bounding an empty face opening or open boundary.

The algorithm is implemented in `SelectHole.PerformActionImplementation` and `ElementSelection.FindHoles`:
1. Input Selection Filtering:
   - If no elements or vertices are selected (`pb.selectedIndexesInternal == null || pb.selectedIndexesInternal.Length < 1`), `selectAll = true` and `indexes` is set to all mesh vertex indices: `pb.facesInternal.SelectMany(x => x.indexes)`.
   - Otherwise, `indexes` is set to `pb.selectedIndexesInternal`.
2. Shared Vertex Conversion: `HashSet<int> common = mesh.GetSharedVertexHandles(indexes)` converts vertex indices to shared vertex handles.
3. Boundary Loop Walking in `FindHoles(List<WingedEdge> wings, HashSet<int> common)`:
   - Iterates through `wings[i]`:
     - Skips if `c.opposite != null` (edge is manifold with an opposite face), `used.Contains(c)`, or neither endpoint `c.edge.common.a` nor `c.edge.common.b` is contained in `common`.
     - Initializes a hole list `List<WingedEdge> hole = new List<WingedEdge>()` and pivot index `int ind = it.edge.common.a`.
     - While `it != null && counter++ < k_MaxHoleIterations` (constant `k_MaxHoleIterations = 2048` prevents infinite recursion on malformed meshes):
       - `used.Add(it); hole.Add(it);`
       - Advances endpoint: `ind = it.edge.common.a == ind ? it.edge.common.b : it.edge.common.a;`.
       - Finds next boundary edge sharing pivot `ind` via `FindNextEdgeInHole(it, ind)`.
       - If `it == c`, the boundary cycle has closed.
4. Boundary Fan Traversal in `FindNextEdgeInHole(WingedEdge wing, int common)`:
   - Gets adjacent winged edge sharing `common` index via `wing.GetAdjacentEdgeWithCommonIndex(common)`.
   - Walks around the triangle fan: `while (next != null && next != wing && counter++ < k_MaxHoleIterations)` -> `if (next.opposite == null) return next; next = next.opposite.GetAdjacentEdgeWithCommonIndex(common);`.
5. Nested Hole Path Splitting:
   - Scans `hole` list for closed sub-loops where `wing.edge.common.b == hole[p].edge.common.a` and records split pairs `(p, n)` in a list.
   - Sorts splits by starting index, extracts sub-ranges, and adjusts index shift offsets.
   - Verifies that each extracted section contains at least one requested index from `common`.
6. Selection Application: Converts winged edges to local edges via `hole.Select(x => x.edge.local)` and applies `pb.SetSelectedEdges(holes.SelectMany(x => x))`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot hole selection can find boundary half-edges where `half_edge.opposite` is invalid, walking `half_edge.next` along the open boundary.

sections.heading: SELECT BY MATERIAL
sections.content:
The Select by Material action selects all faces across the selected objects (or across the entire scene) that share Material assignments with the currently selected faces.

The algorithm is implemented in `SelectMaterial.PerformActionImplementation`:
1. Scope Determination:
   - Evaluates `m_RestrictToSelectedObjects` (`Pref<bool>("SelectMaterial.restrictToSelectedObjects", false, SettingsScope.Project)`):
     - If true ('Current Selection' option enabled): `selection = MeshSelection.topInternal`.
     - If false (default): `selection = EditorUtility.FindObjectsByType<ProBuilderMesh>()` (scans all ProBuilder meshes in the active scene).
2. Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Select Faces with Material")`.
3. Selected Material Gathering:
   - Collects a `HashSet<Material> selectedMaterials = new HashSet<Material>()`.
   - For each `pb` in `MeshSelection.topInternal`:
     - Gathers unique submesh indices from selected faces: `HashSet<int> submeshIndex = new HashSet<int>(pb.selectedFacesInternal.Select(y => y.submeshIndex))`.
     - Retrieves material references: `foreach (var index in submeshIndex) selectedMaterials.Add(pb.renderer.sharedMaterials[index])`.
4. Submesh Index Matching Across Meshes:
   - For each `pb` in `selection`:
     - Maps matching materials to submesh indices: `for (int matIndex = 0; matIndex < pb.renderer.sharedMaterials.Length; ++matIndex) { if (selectedMaterials.Contains(pb.renderer.sharedMaterials[matIndex])) subMeshIndices.Add(matIndex); }`.
     - If `subMeshIndices.Count > 0`:
       - Filters faces: `IEnumerable<Face> matches = pb.facesInternal.Where(x => subMeshIndices.Contains(x.submeshIndex))`.
       - If `matches.Any()`: adds `pb.gameObject` to `List<GameObject> newSelection` and applies `pb.SetSelectedFaces(matches)`.
5. Synchronization: Sets `Selection.objects = newSelection.ToArray()` and executes `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, Material matching maps material slots on `MeshInstance3D` / `ArrayMesh` surfaces to face material IDs.

sections.heading: SELECT BY VERTEX COLOR
sections.content:
The Select by Vertex Color action selects all faces that match the vertex colors of currently selected vertices, edges, or faces.

The algorithm is implemented in `SelectVertexColor.PerformActionImplementation`:
1. Scope Determination:
   - Evaluates `m_SearchSelectedObjectsOnly` (`Pref<bool>("SelectVertexColor.restrictToSelectedObjects", false)`):
     - If true: `pool = MeshSelection.topInternal`.
     - If false (default): `pool = EditorUtility.FindObjectsByType<ProBuilderMesh>()`.
2. Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Select Faces with Vertex Colors")`.
3. Source Color Sampling:
   - Collects `HashSet<Color32> colors = new HashSet<Color32>()`.
   - For each `pb` in `MeshSelection.topInternal`:
     - Validates `pb.colorsInternal != null && pb.colorsInternal.Length == pb.vertexCount`.
     - For each vertex index `i` in `pb.selectedIndexesInternal`, inserts `(Color32)pb.colorsInternal[i]` into `colors`.
4. Color Comparison and Tolerance Model:
   - ProBuilder uses exact 32-bit RGBA byte equality via `Color32` in `HashSet<Color32>`.
   - Quantizing 32-bit floating point `Color` values into 8-bit integers (0 to 255) introduces an implicit quantization tolerance of 1/255 (approximately 0.00392).
   - There is no user-exposed floating-point tolerance slider in the menu settings GUI.
5. Uncolored Mesh Fallback (`colors.Count == 0`):
   - If the source selection has no vertex colors assigned, it matches all faces on meshes where `pb.colorsInternal == null || pb.colorsInternal.Length < 1`.
6. Face Matching (`colors.Count > 0`):
   - For each `pb` in `pool`:
     - Validates vertex color buffer length.
     - For each face `faces[i]` in `pb.facesInternal`:
       - Examines `int[] tris = faces[i].distinctIndexesInternal`.
       - If ANY vertex on the face satisfies `colors.Contains((Color32)mesh_colors[tris[n]])`, adds `faces[i]` to `matches` and proceeds to the next face.
     - If `matches.Count > 0`, adds `pb.gameObject` to `newSelection` and applies `pb.SetSelectedFaces(matches)`.
7. Synchronization: Updates `Selection.objects = newSelection.ToArray()` and calls `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot color matching can compare vertex colors in `Color` format using an explicit float tolerance (e.g. `is_equal_approx`) or 8-bit `Color8` integer equality.

sections.heading: SELECT BY SMOOTHING GROUP
sections.content:
The Select by Smoothing Group action selects all faces on the currently selected objects that share smoothing group IDs with any currently selected face.

The algorithm is implemented in `SelectSmoothingGroup.PerformActionImplementation`:
1. Scope and Visibility:
   - Scope is restricted to `MeshSelection.topInternal` (does not search scene-wide).
   - Property `hidden` returns true (omitted from the main toolbar button strip; displayed in the Smooth Group Editor window and `Tools > ProBuilder > Selection > Select Smoothing Group`).
   - `optionsMenuState` returns `MenuActionState.VisibleAndEnabled` when in Face mode with selected faces.
2. Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Select Faces with Smoothing Group")`.
3. Smoothing Group ID Extraction:
   - Extracts smoothing group IDs: `HashSet<int> selectedSmoothGroups = new HashSet<int>(MeshSelection.topInternal.SelectMany(x => x.selectedFacesInternal.Select(y => y.smoothingGroup)))`.
   - Smoothing group ID 0 represents unsmoothed (hard-edge) faces, while integers 1 through 42 represent smoothing groups.
4. Face Matching:
   - For each `pb` in `MeshSelection.topInternal`:
     - Filters matching faces: `IEnumerable<Face> matches = pb.facesInternal.Where(x => selectedSmoothGroups.Contains(x.smoothingGroup))`.
     - If `matches.Count() > 0`, adds `pb.gameObject` to `newSelection` and applies `pb.SetSelectedFaces(matches)`.
5. Synchronization: Sets `Selection.objects = newSelection.ToArray()`, refreshes via `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`, and returns `ActionResult.Status.Success`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot smooth groups can be matched by comparing integer smooth group IDs assigned to faces before normal generation.

sections.heading: EACH ACTION
sections.content:
Each selection menu action in ProBuilder specifies distinct valid selection modes, enabled verification criteria, settings preferences, modifier shortcuts, and undo registration contracts:

1. `SelectEdgeLoop`:
   - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Edge`.
   - Enabled Condition: `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedEdgeCount > 0`.
   - Settings: `m_SelectIterative` (`Pref<bool>("SelectEdgeLoop.selectIterative", false)`).
   - Modifiers & Shortcuts: `Alt + L` menu shortcut; Double-Click on an edge in Scene view.
   - Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Select Edge Loop")`.
   - Result: Returns Success if `loop.Length > pb.selectedEdgeCount`, else Failure ("Nothing to Loop").

2. `SelectEdgeRing`:
   - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Edge`.
   - Enabled Condition: `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedEdgeCount > 0`.
   - Settings: `m_SelectIterative` (`Pref<bool>("SelectEdgeRing.selectIterative", false)`).
   - Modifiers & Shortcuts: `Alt + R` menu shortcut; `Shift + Double-Click` on an edge in Scene view.
   - Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Select Edge Ring")`.
   - Result: Returns Success if `edges.Length > mesh.selectedEdgeCount`, else Failure ("Nothing to Ring").

3. `SelectFaceLoop`:
   - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Face | SelectMode.TextureFace`.
   - Enabled Condition: `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedFaceCount > 0`.
   - Modifiers & Shortcuts: `Shift + Double-Click` on a face in Scene view.
   - Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Select Face Loop")`.
   - Result: Returns Success ("Select Face Loop").

4. `SelectFaceRing`:
   - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Face | SelectMode.TextureFace`.
   - Enabled Condition: `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedFaceCount > 0`.
   - Modifiers & Shortcuts: `Control + Double-Click` on a face executes `SelectFaceRing.PerformAction()`; `Shift + Control + Double-Click` executes `SelectFaceRing.MenuRingAndLoopFaces(MeshSelection.topInternal)` (selects both ring and loop).
   - Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Select Face Ring")` or `UndoUtility.RecordSelection(selection.ToArray(), "Select Face Ring and Loop")`.
   - Result: Returns Success ("Select Face Ring" / "Select Face Ring and Loop").

5. `SelectHole`:
   - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Vertex | SelectMode.Edge`.
   - Enabled Condition: `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedObjectCount > 0` (operates on whole mesh if vertex/edge count is 0).
   - Shortcuts: Menu `Tools > ProBuilder > Selection > Select Hole`.
   - Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Select Hole")`.
   - Result: Returns Success formatted as `"{0} holes found"` or `"No Holes in Selection"`.

6. `SelectLoop` (Contextual Menu Proxy):
   - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Edge | SelectMode.Face | SelectMode.TextureFace`.
   - Enabled Condition: Delegates to `SelectEdgeLoop.enabled` in Edge mode or `SelectFaceLoop.enabled` in Face mode.
   - Shortcuts: `Alt + L`.
   - Undo Registration: Delegated to underlying action.

7. `SelectRing` (Contextual Menu Proxy):
   - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Edge | SelectMode.Face | SelectMode.TextureFace`.
   - Enabled Condition: Delegates to `SelectEdgeRing.enabled` in Edge mode or `SelectFaceRing.enabled` in Face mode.
   - Shortcuts: `Alt + R`.
   - Undo Registration: Delegated to underlying action.

8. `SelectMaterial`:
   - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Face | SelectMode.TextureFace`.
   - Enabled Condition: `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedFaceCount > 0`.
   - Settings: `m_RestrictToSelectedObjects` (`Pref<bool>("SelectMaterial.restrictToSelectedObjects", false, SettingsScope.Project)`).
   - Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Select Faces with Material")`.
   - Result: Returns Success ("Select Faces with Material").

9. `SelectSmoothingGroup`:
   - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Face | SelectMode.TextureFace`.
   - Enabled Condition: `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedFaceCount > 0`.
   - Visibility: `hidden => true`.
   - Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Select Faces with Smoothing Group")`.
   - Result: Returns Success ("Select Faces with Smoothing Group").

10. `SelectVertexColor`:
    - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Vertex | SelectMode.Edge | SelectMode.Face | SelectMode.TextureFace`.
    - Enabled Condition: `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedVertexCount > 0`.
    - Settings: `m_SearchSelectedObjectsOnly` (`Pref<bool>("SelectVertexColor.restrictToSelectedObjects", false)`).
    - Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Select Faces with Vertex Colors")`.
    - Result: Returns Success ("Select Faces with Vertex Colors").

11. `GrowSelection`:
    - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Vertex | SelectMode.Edge | SelectMode.Face | SelectMode.TextureFace`.
    - Enabled Condition: `base.enabled && VerifyGrowSelection()` where `VerifyGrowSelection()` checks `selectedCount > 0 && selectedCount < totalCount`.
    - Settings: `m_GrowSelectionWithAngle` (`Pref<bool>("GrowSelection.useAngle", true)`), `m_GrowSelectionAngleIterative` (`Pref<bool>("GrowSelection.iterativeGrow", false)`), `m_GrowSelectionAngleValue` (`Pref<float>("GrowSelection.angleValue", 15f)`).
    - Shortcuts: `Alt + G`.
    - Mode Actions: In Vertex/Edge mode, executes `ElementSelection.GetConnectedEdges(pb, pb.selectedIndexesInternal)`. In Face mode, executes `ElementSelection.GrowSelection` (if iterative) or `ElementSelection.FloodSelection` (if flood/non-iterative) with optional normal angle threshold.
    - Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Grow Selection")`.
    - Result: Returns Success if `grown > 0`, else Failure ("Nothing to Grow").

12. `ShrinkSelection`:
    - Valid Modes: `SelectMode.Vertex | SelectMode.Edge | SelectMode.Face | SelectMode.TextureFace`.
    - Enabled Condition: `base.enabled && VerifyShrinkSelection()` where `VerifyShrinkSelection()` checks `selectedCount > 1 && selectedCount < totalCount`.
    - Shortcuts: `Alt + Shift + G`.
    - Mode Actions: In Edge mode, calls `ElementSelection.GetPerimeterEdges` and removes perimeter edges. In Face mode, calls `ElementSelection.GetPerimeterFaces` and removes perimeter faces. In Vertex mode, calls `ElementSelection.GetPerimeterVertices` with `universalEdges` and removes perimeter vertices.
    - Undo Registration: `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Shrink Selection")`.
    - Result: Returns Success if `rc > 0`, else Canceled ("Nothing to Shrink").
sections.godot_notes: All actions map directly to Godot editor menu items, viewport double-click handlers with Shift/Ctrl modifiers, and UndoRedo actions.

cross_references.relationship: ProBuilderMesh core data model storing selected faces (selectedFacesInternal), selected edges (selectedEdges), and selected vertex indices (selectedIndexesInternal)
Topological element primitives including Face, Edge, EdgeLookup, and SharedVertex lookup tables
Selection state management, MeshSelection container, and selection picking modes (Vertex, Edge, Face, TextureFace)
Interactive viewport picking, rectangular selection, and raycasting integration
WingedEdge mesh representation and topology traversal (GetSpokes, NextSpoke, WingedEdgeEnumerator)
MenuAction base class, EditorToolbarLoader, ToolbarGroup, and MenuActionState settings UI
Smoothing Groups editor window integration and SelectSmoothingGroup action invocation

open_questions: SelectVertexColor uses exact Color32 (8-bit integer channel) equality without a configurable floating-point tolerance parameter in its GUI, giving an implicit 1/255 quantization threshold.
